keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Chicago Fire FC 1, Columbus Crew 0. Robert Lewandowski (Chicago Fire FC) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Noah Allen (Chicago Fire FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Chicago Fire FC 1, Columbus Crew 1. Gonzalo Tapia (Columbus Crew) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Taha Habroune.
Goal! Chicago Fire FC 2, Columbus Crew 1. Robert Lewandowski (Chicago Fire FC) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Goal! Chicago Fire FC 2, Columbus Crew 2. Anass Zaroury (Columbus Crew) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
Mbekezeli Mbokazi (Chicago Fire FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Chicago Fire FC 3, Columbus Crew 2. Maren Haile-Selassie (Chicago Fire FC) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal.
First Half ends, Chicago Fire FC 3, Columbus Crew 2.
Substitution, Columbus Crew. Brais Méndez replaces Sékou Bangoura.
Substitution, Chicago Fire FC. Anzor Mekvabishvili replaces Djé D'Avilla.
Substitution, Chicago Fire FC. Andrew Gutman replaces Noah Allen.
Second Half begins Chicago Fire FC 3, Columbus Crew 2.
Jonathan Bamba (Chicago Fire FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Chicago Fire FC 3, Columbus Crew 3. Gonzalo Tapia (Columbus Crew) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Malte Amundsen with a through ball.
Gonzalo Tapia (Columbus Crew) is shown the yellow card.
Delay in match because of an injury Sean Zawadzki (Columbus Crew).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Chicago Fire FC. Jack Elliott replaces Mbekezeli Mbokazi.
Substitution, Chicago Fire FC. André Franco replaces Jonathan Bamba.
Anzor Mekvabishvili (Chicago Fire FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Columbus Crew. André Gomes replaces Dylan Chambost.
Santiago Rodríguez (Columbus Crew) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Chicago Fire FC. Puso Dithejane replaces Philip Zinckernagel.
Substitution, Columbus Crew. Brooks Lennon replaces Mohamed Farsi.
Substitution, Columbus Crew. Andrés Herrera replaces Anass Zaroury.
Substitution, Columbus Crew. Jamal Thiaré replaces Gonzalo Tapia.
Goal! Chicago Fire FC 3, Columbus Crew 4. Brais Méndez (Columbus Crew) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner.
Second Half ends, Chicago Fire FC 3, Columbus Crew 4.
